title: Enhance home page with dynamic product displays and add Shop Details admin section

requirements.summary: Redesign Marketplace home page to display dynamic product sections (featured, most viewed, best sellers, newest designs) with automatic updates when new products are uploaded
acceptanceCriteria: Home page displays a 'Featured Products' section with product cards
Home page displays a 'Most Viewed Products' section with product cards
Home page displays a 'Best Sellers' section showing most sold products
Home page displays a 'Newest Designs' section showing recently added products
Newly uploaded products appear in the appropriate sections when customers visit the home page
Each product section shows product images, names, and prices with links to detail view

file_operations.description: Redesign the Marketplace home page to include four distinct product sections: Featured Products, Most Viewed Products, Best Sellers, and Newest Designs. Each section should display product cards in a horizontal scrollable or grid layout. Use the backend methods getMostViewedProducts(), getBestSellingProducts(), and getNewestProducts() via React Query hooks. For Featured Products, use getProducts() and select featured items (e.g., first 4-6 products). Ensure each product card displays the product image, name, shape, and price, and is clickable to open the ProductDetailView modal. Remove or update the existing static product grid to accommodate the new sectioned layout.

Add three new React Query hooks: useMostViewedProducts(), useBestSellingProducts(), and useNewestProducts(). Each hook should call the corresponding backend method (getMostViewedProducts, getBestSellingProducts, getNewestProducts) and return the product arrays with proper loading and error states. Use query keys ['products', 'mostViewed'], ['products', 'bestSelling'], and ['products', 'newest'] respectively. Ensure these queries are invalidated when products are added or updated to reflect newly uploaded products automatically.

requirements.summary: Update Marketplace home page hero section with new background image and compelling motto about original handcrafted products to attract buyers
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays a new background design with warm, artisan-appropriate colors
Hero section includes a compelling motto about original handcrafted products
Hero section includes promotional text encouraging buyers to explore unique designs
Visual design is cohesive with the existing artisan marketplace aesthetic

file_operations.description: Update the hero section at the top of the Marketplace page to use the generated hero background image located at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-background.dim_1920x600.png. Replace any existing hero banner with a new design featuring this background image. Add a prominent motto headline such as 'Original Handcrafted Products, Designed & Created by Me' or similar compelling text emphasizing originality and craftsmanship. Include a subheading or promotional text encouraging buyers to explore unique, one-of-a-kind designs. Use warm, artisan-appropriate typography and overlay styling that ensures text readability over the background. Maintain cohesion with the existing terracotta and earthy color palette defined in the global styles.

requirements.summary: Create a new 'Shop Details' tab in the admin Dashboard where the trader can configure shop contact email address
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page includes a new 'Shop Details' tab alongside existing tabs
Shop Details tab contains a form with an email input field
Form includes a save button to persist shop contact details
Success/error feedback is displayed when saving shop details
Configured email is loaded and displayed when the tab is opened

file_operations.description: Add a new tab labeled 'Shop Details' to the existing Tabs component in the Dashboard page, alongside the current tabs (Product Management, Bulk Upload, Stripe Configuration, Branding). The Shop Details tab should render a new ShopDetailsSettings component (to be created). Ensure the tab is only accessible to admin users (consistent with existing admin-only dashboard access control). Wire the new tab into the Tabs structure so it can be navigated to and from other tabs.

Create a new component that displays a form for configuring shop contact details. Include an email input field with proper validation (email format). Add a 'Save' button that triggers the useUpdateShopDetails mutation hook. Display the current shop email by fetching data using the useShopDetails query hook. Show success toast notifications on successful save and error messages on failure. Use form state management (e.g., useState) to track email input changes. Style the form consistently with other admin settings components (BrandingSettings, StripeSetup) using Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components like Input, Button, and Label.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hooks for fetching and updating shop details with admin authentication
acceptanceCriteria: useShopDetails hook fetches current shop details from backend
useUpdateShopDetails mutation hook updates shop details with admin authentication
Query cache is invalidated after successful shop details updates
Hooks handle loading and error states appropriately

file_operations.description: Add two new React Query hooks: useShopDetails() and useUpdateShopDetails(). The useShopDetails hook should call actor.getShopDetails() with query key ['shopDetails'], returning the ShopDetails object or null with proper loading and error states. The useUpdateShopDetails mutation hook should call actor.updateShopDetails(details) with the ShopDetails object as input, and on success, invalidate the ['shopDetails'] query key to refresh the cached data. Ensure both hooks check for actor availability and handle errors gracefully. Follow the existing patterns used in other query hooks in this file.

requirements.summary: Update Footer component to display configured contact email from Shop Details as a mailto link in the 'Connect' section
acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays contact email retrieved from shop details configuration
Email is rendered as a clickable mailto link
Contact section shows a label like 'Contact:' or 'Email:' before the email address
If no email is configured, the contact section is hidden or shows placeholder text
Clicking the mailto link opens the user's default email client

file_operations.description: Update the Footer component to fetch shop details using the useShopDetails hook. In the 'Connect' section (or create a new contact section if 'Connect' doesn't exist), display the contact email retrieved from shopDetails.contactDetails.email. Render the email as a clickable mailto link (e.g., {email}). Add a label such as 'Contact:' or 'Email:' before the email address for clarity. If shopDetails is null or email is empty, hide the contact section or display placeholder text like 'Contact information not configured'. Ensure the styling is consistent with the existing footer design and uses Tailwind CSS classes.
